refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoMathTan calculates the tangent of argv[0].

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoMathTan returns a pointer to an object representing the result of the tangent function. If argc is not 1, the returned value will be an error value with value SilikoErrorFunctionArguments.

refsection.title: Conformance
refsection.para: The SilikoMathTan function conforms to Siliko Core’s interface for pure functions and can be installed into a SilikoEngine if wrapped with SilikoPureFunctionCreate.
